last_operator_rollout.issue_198_early_stop: #198 is fixed by #203 in this release. Staging could not show the early stop from outside: Cloudflare holds an unterminated chunked request body and resets it after about 15 s (fetch probe TypeError after 15192 ms; raw TLS chunked probe ECONNRESET after 15133 ms and 40053 bytes sent). The early stop is proven by tests/runtime/platform-json-body.test.ts (source cancelled before draining; declared oversize never pulled) in verify run 37630943060, and the staging json_stream_limit_413 check proves the bounded path is live.
last_operator_rollout.rollback: Redeploy 8d2213d7 to the affected Worker(s); no schema restore is needed. Migrations 120-124 add new tables (seeding rows into two of them), and 121/123 also change existing objects: nullable columns, foreign keys and uniques on resource_scopes, work_items, assets and asset_upload_intents; a widened scope_kind expression on work_items; widened CHECKs on those tables and on scoped_command_receipts, scoped_transition_journal, scoped_outbox and asset_objects; and three trigger functions that now also guard the new columns. Each change only adds a tenant branch or a column that 8d2213d7 leaves NULL, the new foreign keys are MATCH SIMPLE, and the new trigger acts only on tenant_execution rows (diffed in a scratch database: compat-schema-diff.json; live rows checked before migrating: precheck-constraints.json). A data restore would start from the before-migration backup set (production ce4913c6-413a-4d60-ad06-89bab1381e27, staging 723736c4-918c-4708-8e65-f76c36a838ee).
